mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases when RSAFS increases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening economy, which is generally positive for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases when INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously, it indicates a robust labor market, which can lead to higher consumer spending and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, which is generally positive for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) indicates weakening demand in the housing sector, which can lead to a broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases when HOUST decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong economy with low unemployment, which is positive for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases when INDPRO increases and UNRATE decreases.
